description: A hierarchical rollup, for one fiscal year, of a ledger and its groups, funds, budgets and budget expense classes

fiscalYearId.description: UUID of the fiscal year this hierarchy is scoped to

fiscalYearCode.description: The code of the fiscal year

groups.description: The groups associated, for this fiscal year, with funds belonging to this ledger

funds.description: The funds belonging to this ledger that are not associated with any group for this fiscal year
